title: CheckRecord
description: One published pairwise check. One record per unordered pair of source_digest values, stored in lexicographic order. A second write of the same pair is the same check and does not replace daemon_id. conflict is symmetric. Both digests belong to completed extracts. A missing or failed check is not a record and is not conflict false. daemon_id is the daemon that ran the check. It is not part of the pair. Subentity of signoff, not an entity on factory #935. The boolean is conflict. ADR-0033. ADR-0034.

domain_digest.description: Lexicographically lesser source_digest of the pair.

other_domain_digest.description: Lexicographically greater source_digest of the pair. Differs from domain_digest.

conflict.description: True when this pair is in conflict. No other relation class is stored.

daemon_id.description: Daemon that ran this check and wrote the record. Not part of the pair key. The same field as Signoff.daemon_id.
